description: FlyingClimate contains code associated with a research study quantifying aviation's contribution to global warming. Its README identifies the paper and releases the calculations used to connect aviation emissions and non-CO2 effects to warming. Users need historical flight-emission assumptions and model settings; outputs are estimated warming contributions over the study years or scenarios. Geographic coverage is global aviation activity in the supplied inputs. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing. A limitation is that climate-response estimates are aggregate and cannot describe local airport air quality, flight delay or the operational capacity of an airfield. Non-CO2 effects also have substantial scientific uncertainty. The model can provide climate-impact context for aviation infrastructure scenarios. The related catalogue AequilibraE record covers ground transport-network analysis, not aviation forcing. No emissions data or software was downloaded.
name: FlyingClimate aviation warming model
notes: G7 G7-1707. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
